scopeNote: Covers the City of New Orleans, which shares its boundary with Orleans Parish. Neighboring parishes such as Jefferson and St. Bernard keep their own permit and code-enforcement records.

violations.coverage: New Orleans code-enforcement cases, about 183,000 filed July 2008 to present, refreshed daily.

permits.coverage: New Orleans permits of every type, about 348,000 filed 2002 to present, refreshed daily.

source.name: City of New Orleans Open Data
source.license: CC0 1.0 public domain dedication (City of New Orleans)
source.currentRecordsNote: Code-enforcement cases and permits are both published on NOLA Open Data. The violations address is the case's location column, which keeps address ranges ("3642-3644 Laurel St") and is filled on more rows than the geocoded address.
